headline: Gaziantep call a congress after 3 defeats — and stay favourites
summary: Gaziantep FK host Erzurumspor on Saturday with the club in the middle of a leadership fight: an extraordinary congress is set for 5 November, after 3 straight Süper Lig defeats. The visitors are the better-placed side and have won 3 of their last 5 — but every one of those wins came at home. Gaziantep's own defence is the worry, allowing 2.1 expected goals a game, and the club is giving 5,000 free tickets to students to fill the ground. Even so, the market makes the home side 41.8% favourites, though the handicap has them only a quarter of a goal ahead, with the goals line at 2.25 and over at 50.9%.
read: Gaziantep FK host Erzurumspor as 41.8% favourites even though they have lost their last three matches and the club has called an extraordinary congress for 5 November. Erzurumspor arrive with three wins in five and a defence that has conceded just three goals in the same span, but the market still rates them a quarter of a goal weaker and sees a game hovering right around 2.25 goals.

facts.fact: Gaziantep FK are the favourites at 41.8% to win, more than one and a half times Erzurumspor's chance.
facts.meaning: The market makes the home side clear favourites, even though the visitors arrive in far better form.

facts.fact: Gaziantep have lost their last three Süper Lig matches — form LLLDW.
facts.meaning: They have not won since early September and come in off a defeat at Başakşehir, so this is a side short of confidence.

facts.fact: Gaziantep have called an extraordinary elective general assembly for 5 November at Gaziantep Büyükşehir Stadium.
facts.meaning: A leadership vote two weeks away hangs over the club while the team is on a three-match losing run.

facts.fact: Erzurumspor have won three of their last five — form WDWLW — including 2-0 at home to Eyüpspor last Saturday.
facts.meaning: The visitors are the side arriving with momentum, three points and three places better off than Gaziantep.

facts.fact: Erzurumspor have 11 points from eight games and sit above Gaziantep in the Süper Lig table.
facts.meaning: The table says the away side is the better-placed team, the price says the opposite — home advantage is doing that work.

facts.fact: Erzurumspor have conceded just 3 goals in their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They are a low-scoring, hard-to-break-down side — this is not a game where the home team is expected to run away with it.

facts.fact: Gaziantep have allowed an average of 2.1 xG per game across their last five.
facts.meaning: They are giving up good chances regularly — the home defeat to Çorum was the clearest example of how open they have been.

facts.fact: The Asian handicap fair line is -0.25 for Gaziantep.
facts.meaning: The market rates the home side only about a quarter of a goal better — it expects a tight match, not a comfortable home win.

sources.fact: Gaziantep FK has decided to hold an extraordinary elective general assembly on Thursday 5 November at 14:00 at Gaziantep Büyükşehir Stadium, with a second session on 12 November if there is no quorum.
Local media report that the extraordinary congress decision was taken due to financial difficulties and a lack of expected support.
Gaziantep FK's preparations for the Erzurumspor match continued under head coach Orhan Ak with a 1 hour 10 minute session of passing drills and an in-house match.
Gaziantep FK lost 2-1 away at Başakşehir in their most recent match.
TFF referred Gaziantep FK head coach Orhan Ak to the PFDK disciplinary board, according to the TFF's published statement.
Gaziantep FK are reported to be among the Süper Lig clubs currently under a transfer registration ban due to a FIFA file.
Erzurumspor FK beat Eyüpspor 2-0 at home in week 8, with headed goals from Cardoso and Eren Tozlu.
Erzurumspor FK head coach Serkan Özbalta said after the Eyüpspor win: "We are after every match and every point."
